notes.title: Update 1.16. New English localization!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A few minor changes related to gameplay usability.
[*] Several bugs have been fixed.
[*] English localization has been reworked from scratch. Thanks @toomanynights for volunteering to help! A few words from the proofreader himself:
[/list]
While playing the game, I felt that the English localization lacked a bit of polishing, and the developers gave me full carte blanche to fix it. I tried my best to make the descriptions, diary entries, and menus as clear and intuitive as possible. But of course, the most overwhelming task and the biggest fun for me were the dialogues, as they required not only proofreading but also stylizing with the characters' backgrounds in mind, which sometimes even required lowering the initial text quality. Now Karl, an immigrant presumably from Germany, speaks a mix of English and German; a special tools salesman will actually try a few pitches on you; and Jack himself, excited about his new line of work, has adopted a moderate "guy from the streets" persona. I hope you will enjoy playing Gone Rogue with the revised texts, and if you have anything to say about this change, I'll be glad to hear your feedback.😊

notes.title: New "survival" difficulty added!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The highest "survival" difficulty has been added. Recommended for experienced players or for repeated playthroughs. This difficulty cannot be lowered during the game.
[*] Quality of Polish localization has been improved. Thanks to Mateusz Kwapisz for this!
[*] Vegetation quality setting has been added to improve performance on weak computers.
[/list]

More information about the new difficulty:
[list]
[*][b]Food supplies[/b] 
After each robbery, Jack needs to leave a supply of food in the house. If not enough food is stored, Jack will feel hungry during the next robbery and some of his stats will decrease. But if Jack manages to fill his food stores to 100%, he will be full of strength and will be able to carry 5 kg more. Note that more food will need to be stockpiled with each new housemate.
[*][b]Police search[/b]
The more evidence Jack leaves behind during robberies, the more the police search for Jack, and the more difficult it becomes to commit further robberies. Accordingly, Jack can be in one of four states: unsuspected, suspicious person, wanted, public enemy.
The increase of the police search is affected by: general alarm on the robbery, attacks on hostile characters, the amount of stolen items.
There are several ways to lower the police wanted level, for this we advise you to talk to Bill or Albert.
[*][b]Hostile Character Behavior[/b]
Characters behave more unpredictably. They now change their routes more often, wait different times, look in different directions, etc. Hostile characters have an increased field of view as their alertness increases.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Work on optimizing the game has been done. The game performance has been improved by 5-10% (depending on the location);
[*] Added the possibility to load any completed chapter directly from the game menu;
[*] In case of loss or corruption of save files, now they are periodically duplicated in the SavesBackUp folder in the game folder.
[*] Slightly improved the quality of NPC fields of view.
[*] Halloween challenge is now available only after completing 3 chapters of the story.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Update Is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow thieves! The Halloween spirit has descended upon the State, and Jack is ready to embark on a new adventure. However, this time, his target won't be the treasure of the wealthy but their rotten souls.

Here's what awaits you in Update 1.13:
[list]
[*] New Halloween Mission for the " Challenge" Mode - A timely heist that, temporarily, will be available to all players who have completed at least one chapter in the main storyline (equivalent to 4 heists). Afterwards, the mission will only unlock after finishing three chapters.
[*] Pumpkin Mask - A special reward for completing all the mission goals. To obtain it, search Jack's house in the main storyline of the game.
[*] Immerse yourself in the Halloween atmosphere with two new musical compositions.
[*] The world of crime is ever-evolving, and now you'll face new challenges and rewards. Difficulty in chapters 4 and 5 has been increased. There have been adjustments to the balance of prices, loot, skills and experience gained. Get ready for a real challenge, especially if you're playing on the highest difficulty!
[/list]

The Halloween celebration has begun! Fearlessly embark on your heist and don't forget to put on your Pumpkin Mask! ːThePhantomː

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
[list]
[*] More than 50 new items, objects and furniture have been added to the game. To avoid bugs, some missions will be reloaded from the beginning, we apologize for the inconvenience.
[*] We resisted for a long time, but we finally added a "Sort Price/Weight" button to the inventory. Sorting now takes item names into account. 
[*] You can now combine two partially used items into one whole item (feature available in slums).
[*] New jazz music is now playing in the bar.
[*] The "Smuggling" quest now has an additional reward for completing it.
[*] Detailed item descriptions have been added to the crafting window.
[*] At the end of a robbery, the option to load the last save file has been added.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Japanese localization. Thanks to Hiroshi Ashida for this!
[*] The game is now a little easier on the easy difficulty.
[*] Slightly improved balance and fixed many different bugs.
[*] Free game demo is now available for download on the game page.
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
This update contains only bug fixes and some localization fixes.
In the next update we will try to please you with more significant improvements to the game.

notes.title: Updates 1.00 -> 1.03
notes.content:
Over the past week, we have mainly been fixing various bugs and improving the interface of the game. But there are a few big changes that you will be interested to know about:
[list]
[*] When a tool is selected, the noise radius is displayed in advance.
[*] Franco can now restore the durability of computer hacking tools. Rudolph can restore the durability of acid.
[*] Motion Blur can now be disabled in the settings, if desired.
[*] The Pause, Accelerate, and Auto-Pause buttons are now colored red for better visibility.
[*] A few minor changes on some missions.
[/list]

notes.title: Summary of the year
notes.content:
Happy New Year, friends!
We have already written about our future plans, now it's time to sum up the results of the past year. Well, a lot of work has been done:
[list]
[*] The storyline and all planned secondary quests are completely finished. In total, the game will be more than 30 quests.
[*] Most of the game's locations were created this year.
[*] Improved meta-progression: developing skills, gaining specializations, new tools and used items.
[*] Added or improved a lot of game mechanics: the system of hiding, new ways to distract NPC, crafting items, lighting control (including NPC have learned to use lanterns) and much more.
[*] If we talk about the changes that have occurred recently:
[/list]
[list]
[*] German localization has been added (mostly using machine translation, but with the most important parts proofread and edited). Soon the game will be translated into French, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian. If you want Gone Rogue to have a high-quality localization in your native language, we invite you to take part in the proofreading and editing of the translation.
[*] Added English voice-over for the opening cutscenes (thanks to talented voice actor Chad Johnson).
[*] Based on the results of the closed testing we are preparing a lot of improvements to the interface and gameplay.
[/list]
We're not stopping there and continuing to work harder than ever. See you at Steam Next Fest in just over a month!
